newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Korea Mobile cut.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Korea Mobile cut.

text.p: -- Deutsche Morgan Grenfell said on Tuesday it had downgraded its rating for Korea Mobile Telecom Co to near-term hold from near-term buy.
-- The brokerage also said it kept Korea Mobile at long-term buy.

-- The company, the main provider in the Korean cellular market, "has acquired small stakes in two smaller companies within its broader business group (the Sunkyong group) for about $57 million altogether," analyst Viktor Shvets wrote in a report.
-- "We think this is bad news for KMT's ADRs (American Depositary Receipts), since it implies that management is willing to utilize KMT's funds for allied companies."
-- Shvets reduced his earnings estimates "minimally for 1996 and 1997 and by 16 percent for 1998 and we've downgraded our short-term rating to hold from buy."
-- He added, "Nevertheless, we believe KMT's ADRs remain significantly undervalued and we reaffirm our longer-term buy recommendation."
-- The company's ADR fell 1/8 to 11-5/8 at Tuesday's opening.
